description: This file defines a JSON serializer for Java's java.time.ZonedDateTime objects, converting them into long epoch milliseconds for JSON serialization within the Fineract API infrastructure.

classes.name: JodaDateTimeAdapter
classes.description: A serializer for ZonedDateTime objects that converts the date-time to epoch milliseconds in JSON format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Overrides the serialize method to convert ZonedDateTime to a JSON primitive long representing milliseconds since epoch.
